faq.q: Does the PRO plan limit the number of quiz attempts?
faq.a: No. With a PRO subscription, you can take the Holland test and receive detailed AI analytics an unlimited number of times.
We support bank transfers via QR code (VietQR) and major payment gateways. Your account is upgraded instantly after payment succeeds.

faq.q: How does school partnership (EDU Plan) work?
faq.a: Schools can click "Contact for Schools". Our team will reach out directly to set up individual logins and custom analytics dashboards for all students.
